name: Layan
intro: Layan is a quiet beach at the northern end of Bang Tao Bay, bordering Sirinat National Park. It offers a more natural, low-density setting while staying within minutes of Laguna, Bang Tao and the airport road.
overview:
Layan is the beach area on Phuket's west coast north of Bang Tao, in Choeng Thale, Thalang district; Layan Beach borders Sirinat National Park. Our catalogue lists six projects here: the branded beachfront condominium Kiara Reserve Residences next to the Anantara Layan resort, the hillside condominiums Ayana Heights and The Terrace by AYANA by AYANA Phuket, the large phased Layan Verde by VillaCarte, and the pool-villa communities Aileen Villas Layan and Pavara Vhana Collection.
Advertised starting prices run from THB 3.3 million (a 32 sqm unit at The Terrace by AYANA, launch price list of November 2026) to about THB 98 million for the largest villas, making Layan both an entry point to new condos near the beach and the premium end of our catalogue. Projects that are only near Layan Beach, such as Layan Green Park, are listed under their primary location (Cherng Talay) and mention Layan as a nearby area.
suitableFor: Buyers who want a quieter beach
highlights: Unspoilt beach next to a national park
Close to Bang Tao, Laguna and the airport
Mix of resort condos and luxury villas

lifestyle: Layan is calm, with a few beach restaurants and resorts. Daily shopping and dining are in nearby Bang Tao, Laguna and Boat Avenue.
beaches: Layan Beach is a peaceful, partly tree-lined beach next to Sirinat National Park, known for sunsets and horse riding on the sand. It is good for swimming in the dry season.
rentalMarket: Layan appeals to holiday guests who want quiet surroundings and to long-stay residents who still want Bang Tao services nearby. It is a smaller, more niche market than Bang Tao.

rentalDetails.title: Short-term holiday rentals
rentalDetails.text: Guests looking for nature and calm; demand follows the dry season.

rentalDetails.title: Long-term rentals
rentalDetails.text: Families and professionals who want space and quiet within reach of schools and shops.

rentalDetails.title: Suitable property types
rentalDetails.text: Resort condos with good facilities; pool villas.

rentalDetails.title: Advantages and limitations
rentalDetails.text: Advantage: natural setting and limited development near the national park. Limitations: fewer local amenities on foot; you need a car or scooter.

investment: Buyers choose Layan for its quiet, natural setting close to the services of Bang Tao. New large-scale projects are adding supply, so look at location within Layan and the distance to the beach.

investmentDetails.title: Typical investor profiles
investmentDetails.text: Lifestyle buyers, villa owners and condo buyers in resort-style projects.

investmentDetails.title: Risks to consider
investmentDetails.text: Large new projects competing for tenants; long construction schedules for phased developments.

investmentDetails.title: Ownership costs
investmentDetails.text: Common fees, sinking fund, management, maintenance and insurance.

faq.question: Where is Layan Beach?
faq.answer: Layan Beach is at the northern end of Bang Tao Bay on Phuket's west coast, next to Sirinat National Park.

faq.question: Which new condominiums are being built in Layan?
faq.answer: Our catalogue lists The Terrace by AYANA (launched November 2026, units from THB 3.3 million), Ayana Heights (completion planned for 2027) and the phased Layan Verde (completion planned for 2028), plus the completed beachfront Kiara Reserve Residences.

faq.question: Is Layan quieter than Bang Tao?
faq.answer: Yes. Layan has far fewer bars and restaurants on the beach, while Bang Tao's services are a few minutes away by car.

faq.question: How far is Layan from Phuket airport?
faq.answer: Our project data gives about 15 km to Phuket International Airport, usually 20 to 25 minutes by car.

faq.question: Is Layan good for families?
faq.answer: Layan suits families who want a calm beach and space, with schools and shopping in nearby Bang Tao and Laguna.

faq.question: Can you swim at Layan Beach?
faq.answer: Yes, in the dry season. As elsewhere on the west coast, check the flags from about May to October.
